source: FHWA NGSIM Lankershim, June 16 2005; raw Camera 4
camera_scope: Main Street / MTA Driveway intersection and Section 4; confirm calibrated footprint before scoring
sequence_identity: global_time - (frame_id - 1) * 100 milliseconds; preserve this in vehicle keys
overlap_policy: Source videos extend outside their filename windows. Final scoring begins 08:48 PDT, after the first recording ends; exclude whole tracks crossing partition boundaries. Do not infer independence from different recording filenames.
inspection_log: Before freeze: public metadata, file sizes, archive directories/CRC, full table timestamp ranges and counts, Camera 4 first frame, development annotated frames 100 and 600 plus corresponding development source rows. Frame 600 is within the first development window.
Before freeze: support geometry, first-period analysis-report maps, controller timing sheets and 08:27-08:32 split-monitor rows. No final holdout outcomes scored or used to select a model.

perception.model: YOLOv8n-VisDrone; existing pinned ATLAS pretrained aerial weights
perception.selection: Development starting configuration based on overhead camera geometry; no NGSIM holdout tuning. Any changes must be logged before final scoring.

independent_reference: FHWA video-transcribed and manually corrected source trajectories, never ATLAS predictions or SUMO-generated labels
calibration: Manual source-footprint correspondences and static image registration using development footage only; report residuals and a separate validation set. Global survey feet = 1200/3937 m; local documented feet = 0.3048 m. Do not assign physical speeds without defensible calibration.
simulation_inputs: Documented geometry and controller timing; explicitly observed boundary entry times/lanes and entry speed are conditional inputs. Held-out interior trajectories, queues, speeds, exit times and per-vehicle speed commands are prohibited physical-model inputs.
simulation_outputs: Actual free-running SUMO positions/speeds/queues/crossings, plus separately labelled optional observed-trajectory visualization
primary_metrics: tracking identity and position error with match coverage
crossing-count MAE and bias per direction and 30-second bin
matched segment travel-time MAE and bias with censoring
matching: Use fixed coordinate-space gating and one-to-one assignment; select exact gate and observation polygon on development/validation before final scoring. Report eligible/matched/unmatched counts; no missing prediction converted to zero speed/travel time.
queue_definition: Observed vehicles slower than 0.5 m/s for at least 2 seconds within a fixed upstream lane segment; publish lane mapping, visible extent, counts and queue-length approximation limits.
uncertainty: Report source positional accuracy estimates (~2 ft lateral, ~4 ft longitudinal), calibrated residuals, temporal-block uncertainty and unmatched/censored coverage. One corridor on one date cannot establish cross-city or cross-day validity.
acceptance: A complete decoded/processed video, actual corresponding SUMO run and quantitative independent comparison are mandatory even if errors are poor. A claim of acceptable physical fidelity additionally requires frozen per-metric thresholds documented before final scoring; absent thresholds or failed errors mean unvalidated, no field-benefit claim.
counterfactuals: Only after the video reconstruction milestone; separate simulated controller outcomes from observed real-world interventions. No optimization on final holdout.
